source_snapshot.procedure: Enter each BIOS Advanced disk page, inspect its information and repeat for all disks; KIOXIA NVMe SSD is only an example; source also clears logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All disks' information should be correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly requires an operator to traverse BIOS disk pages but supplies no complete expected inventory, field matrix or controller/slot correlation.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; requires every expected/displayed disk, field-level comparison, protected BIOS evidence, optional read-only OS corroboration and explicit prohibition of storage mutation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: The manual scope is correct but `all` cannot be proven from the example device or a page screenshot without a reconciled expected/displayed inventory.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Classification and read-only controls are accepted; completeness is strengthened with bidirectional expected-versus-displayed set reconciliation and stable per-disk identity mapping.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or earlier completed record.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Disk correctness requires both field accuracy and population completeness; serial/model alone may collide, so controller, BDF/slot/namespace and capacity context are needed to detect missing, duplicate or substituted devices.

original_test_intent: Have a qualified operator inspect every BIOS-visible disk and prove the displayed inventory and fields match the complete owner-approved platform storage population without invoking any disk action.
original_method: Bind the SUT/BIOS and expected storage topology, collect read-only OS/controller inventory for correlation, traverse every BIOS disk page, capture field values and stable identities, reconcile expected and displayed sets in both directions, and exit without selecting diagnostics, erase, format or configuration controls.
manual_activity: The storage owner supplies the complete inventory/topology; a qualified operator traverses and captures every BIOS disk page while avoiding all action controls.
required_inputs: Complete expected disk count and population
Per-disk model, capacity, firmware and protected serial policy
Controller, PCIe BDF, backplane/bay/slot and namespace mapping where applicable
BIOS page path and displayed-field schema
Sensitive-identity redaction and protected storage policy
safety_requirements: Do not select self-test, format, sanitize, erase, secure erase, firmware or configuration actions
Do not guess disk identity or rely on enumeration order
Treat the KIOXIA name as an example only
Do not clear dmesg, syslog, SEL, SMART or error logs
Protect serials and customer storage identity
Stop on missing/extra/duplicate/ambiguous devices or unexpected action prompts
agent_execution_scope: Coordinate but do not claim BIOS UI traversal
Bind operator captures to stable disk/topology identity
Report every field mismatch and missing/extra/duplicate finding
Perform no storage mutation and issue no verdict
engineer_actions: Approve complete disk topology and field criteria
Resolve redaction, ambiguous mappings and hot-spare/absent policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its operator-only BIOS read is applicable, but it lacks an inventory oracle and cannot prove that every disk was covered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual operator: traverse every BIOS disk entry and capture all displayed fields; reconcile against the complete topology, with read-only OS/controller evidence used only for correlation and no disk action selected.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-disk BIOS inspection and 20/20-minute estimates remain; example vendor identity is not generalized and log clearing is prohibited.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a per-disk matrix keyed by stable controller/topology identity with expected and BIOS-observed model, capacity, firmware and redacted serial, then reconcile set completeness before field correctness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a complete oracle, bidirectional set checks and stable topology correlation while remaining read-only.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS inventory supports mapping but cannot replace the BIOS pages; one example disk cannot prove all populated devices.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BIOS may omit fields or aggregate namespaces; vendor/controller-specific presentation requires owner mapping rather than guessed equivalence.

project_override_considerations: A remote-console capture system may assist, but evidence must still show every BIOS entry. Redfish/OS storage inventory is supplementary unless the project explicitly approves equivalence to the BIOS display requirement.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS identity, complete expected inventory/topology and redaction policy
Protected BIOS overview and page evidence for every displayed disk
Expected/displayed set reconciliation for missing, extra, duplicate and ambiguous devices
Optional full read-only OS/controller/PCIe inventory and preserved event evidence
No-mutation/no-save audit and engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require read-only BIOS information checks for all disks. The example device and missing inventory are readiness inputs, not conflicting scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual comparison is deterministic once the owner supplies the complete disk topology, field oracle, operator and redaction policy.

review_improvement: Turns an unbounded visual check into complete, bidirectional and topology-bound disk inventory reconciliation while explicitly prohibiting adjacent storage actions.
independent_technical_reasoning: Field accuracy and inventory completeness are separate invariants: every displayed disk can look correct while an expected drive is missing, and duplicate model/capacity values can hide a substitution. Stable controller/bay/serial correlation and both set directions are therefore necessary.
